component.name: Epic Games Launcher
component.summary: Download, install, and play games from the Epic Games Store

description.p: The Epic Games Launcher is the gateway to all content on the Epic Games store. Install games from your Epic Games account, browse the store, or manage Unreal Engine installations.

screenshot.caption: The "Library" tab, showing a lot of installed games, along with the social panel on the right
The game details pop-up, visible after clicking a game in the library
The "Store" tab, prominently showing the banner of a recently released game
The "Develop" tab, where Unreal Engine installations and related tools can be installed

description.p: The launcher will now tell you when the drive a game is installed on has errors.
The Library list view will now open on your most recently played game.
The update status in Settings > About will now show the version number of the new build.
Paused changes to a game's installed components sometimes couldn't be resumed after a launcher update.
